correctness.rationale: The finite Heisenberg group Fourier decomposition has p^2 scalar and p-1 degree-p blocks; each latter block occurs p times. Three distinct line-average rank-one projections have pairwise trace 1/p and triple trace p^-2 times an explicitly derived nonzero quadratic Gauss sum. This fixes the 3x3 Gram characteristic polynomial, with p-3 extra zero dimensions per block. Strict Gershgorin positivity holds for p>=5. Direct F3 residues give Re q=0 if B=0 and 1/6 otherwise; counting normalized subgroup lifts gives 36 and 72. The final standalone checker reproduces 6 complete regular spectra, 24 Gauss block identities, all 108 p3 subgroup triples and 2 exact integer ranks.

Its normal-operator spectrum controls recoverable dimension and all positive singular values. The prime-dependent rank formula and exceptional six-dimension loss in characteristic three are structural, and the 108-case subgroup census covers the complete natural smallest-prime geometry. The result has standalone mathematical utility without an asserted downstream theorem.
